dedup_note: The two exports are rolling windows and overlap heavily by date range (2072 of 5000 rows in the 09-27 file are the exact same signals already in the 09-20 file). scripts/analyze_signals.py now dedupes on (date, match, strategy, signal minute) before combining files. An earlier version of this file used the raw 10000-row sum, which double-counted ~2072 signals - all numbers below are the corrected, deduped ones.
breakeven_odds_formula: mindestquote = 1 / win_rate  (decimal odds needed so that, at this win rate, wins on average cover losses; anything below this quote runs at a loss even if the win rate holds)

MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5.note: Confirmed across two overlapping-but-deduped exports (n=3493 unique signals): win rate holds well through minute 67 (mostly 65-80%), then drops at 68-70 (69%, 44%, 53%) before a noisy late bounce. Tightening the upper cutoff trades volume for precision.

MoneyBag + 3 Goals -> Over 3.5.note: Minutes 60-63 solid (67-77%), then a dip at 64-65 (~63%), partial recovery at 66-67, decay again through 71. <=63 is the conservative cutoff; the 66-67 recovery is noisier and not worth complicating the rule for.

Over 2.5 Odd Filter.note: New variant, first seen in the 2026-09-27 export only (no overlap with 09-20, so n is unaffected by the dedup fix). Performance and time-decay pattern are statistically indistinguishable from the base 'MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5' strategy, so the same dakika<=67 cutoff applies. Only one week of data so far; re-check once a second export confirms the pattern.

Over 0.5 Value.note: Signals fire almost exclusively at minute 61-62 despite the rule allowing up to 79'; minute 61 (72.0%) slightly outperforms 62 (69.2%). Too little data past minute 62 to judge whether the wide 61-79 window is actually a risk - most of it appears unused in practice.

MoneyBag 0-0 -> Goal.note: Same pattern as 'Over 0.5 Value': signals cluster at minute 61-62. Minute 61 (75.5%, n=94) outperforms minute 62 (68.6%, n=51). No signals observed yet in the 63-71 range to evaluate.

Over 1.5.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5.note: Strong at minute 60-64 (76.7%, n=103), thinner and weaker at 65-69 (63.2%, n=19) and >=70 (68.8%, n=16) - directionally consistent with the main strategies' time decay but too small to act on here.

Over 1.5 cloude.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 cloude.note: Same shape as 'Over 1.5': 78.0% at minute 60-64 (n=91), dropping to 68.2%/61.1% for 65-69/>=70 (n=22/18). Consistent with time decay but sample too small to change the rule confidently.

Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 10 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.note: Best-performing of the three Over 1.5 variants (76.5% vs 73.9-74.0%), and unlike the other two it holds up at 65-69' too (78.3%, n=23). Still a small sample - worth watching as the strongest of the three, not yet enough to retire the others.

HT over 0.5.current_rule: dakika <= 20 | dakika >= 10 | maviBomba = 1 | rx <= 178 | s5 >= 2 | toplamGol <= 1 | toplamSut >= 3 | vanPersie = 1
HT over 0.5.recommended_rule: dakika <= 20 | dakika >= 10 | maviBomba = 1 | rx <= 178 | s5 >= 3 | toplamGol <= 1 | toplamSut >= 3 | vanPersie = 1
HT over 0.5.note: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: an earlier version of this report claimed 'confirmed weak in two independent weekly samples' - that was wrong, caused by a dedup bug (see dedup_note). The 09-27 export added zero new HT over 0.5 signals; there is only ever been this one set of 40. Re-analyzed the 40 signals' own feature values (rx, shots, last-5min-shots) for a better sub-rule: raising the 's5' (last-5min-shots) threshold from >=2 to >=3 lifts win rate from 57.5% (n=40) to 66.7% (n=18) - the largest subset that shows a real improvement (rx-only thresholds only look good at n<15, likely noise). This is a hypothesis from a single 40-signal batch, NOT a validated fix - treat it as 'try this, re-check after the next 1-2 exports', not as solved. If s5>=3 doesn't hold up, the strategy still needs a harder look (different features, or retire it).

breakeven_odds_by_signal_minute.note: Mindestquote per signal-minute bucket, overall across strategies, both exports combined and deduped (n=7928).

breakeven_odds_by_strategy_and_signal_mi.note: Mindestquote per strategy x signal-minute bucket (n>=15), both exports combined and deduped. avg_over_odds is the observed average Over-odds for that combination. margin = avg_over_odds - breakeven_odds.

tool_calibration.note: Source of truth for tools/moneybag-analyst.html's DEFAULT_CALIB. Recomputed 2026-09-27 from both exports combined and deduped (n=3498 for O2.5, n=2811 for O3.5). Replaces the previous 2026-09-20-only calibration.

radar_x_score.note: No strong monotonic relationship with win rate (72-75% across all buckets from <200 to >=450 in the deduped combined dataset). Not currently a reliable standalone filter for the main strategies.

market_drop_pct.note: Mostly flat (71-74%) up to 20% drop, then a dip at 20-30% (66.1%, n=183), then back up at >=30% (72.8%, n=254). No clean monotonic pattern - likely too noisy on these sample sizes to act on yet.
